words.us: soʊ smɔːl θɪŋz kæn ˈriːəli əˈfekt mi
words.ex: So small things can really affect me.
words.ex_cn: 所以小事真的能影响我。
words.en: Minor events or details can have a significant emotional impact on me.

words.tr: phrase. 微波炉、咖啡机、洗衣机（家用电器组合表述）
words.ex: She uses a microwave, a coffee maker, and a washing machine in her small apartment.
words.ex_cn: 她的小公寓里有一台微波炉、一台咖啡机和一台洗衣机。
words.en: A compact appliance that can brew coffee, heat food, and wash clothes.

words.tr: phrase. 非常方便的；极其便利的
words.ex: This app is super convenient for shopping.
words.ex_cn: 这个应用购物时非常方便。
words.en: Extremely useful and saves time and effort.

words.w: especially when I'm in a rush
words.tr: phrase. 尤其是当我赶时间的时候
words.uk: ɪˈspeʃəli wɛn aɪm ɪn ə rʌʃ
words.us: ɪˈspɛʃəli wɛn aɪm ɪn ə rʌʃ
words.ex: I make more mistakes especially when I'm in a rush.
words.ex_cn: 我尤其在赶时间的时候会犯更多错误。
words.en: Particularly when I am short of time and need to be quick.

words.w: Doing laundry by hand is really exhausting
words.tr: 用手洗衣服真的很累人
words.uk: ˈduːɪŋ ˈlɔːndri baɪ hænd ɪz ˈrɪəli ɪɡˈzɔːstɪŋ
words.us: ˈduɪŋ ˈlɔːndri baɪ hænd ɪz ˈriːəli ɪɡˈzɔːstɪŋ
words.ex: Doing laundry by hand is really exhausting.
words.ex_cn: 手洗衣服真的很累人。
words.en: Washing clothes manually is very tiring and demanding.

words.tr: phrase. 腾出我的时间；使我的时间空闲出来
words.ex: This app helps to free up my time.
words.ex_cn: 这个应用程序帮我腾出时间。
words.en: To make time available by reducing other commitments or tasks.

words.tr: phrase. 遵循指示；按照说明行事
words.ex: Follow the instructions to turn on the machine.
words.ex_cn: 按照指示打开机器。
words.en: To obey the directions or guidelines given.

words.tr: phrase. 阅读指南；阅读说明书
words.ex: He read the guide before starting the task.
words.ex_cn: 他在开始任务前读了指南。
words.en: To read a set of instructions or information carefully to understand something.

words.tr: phrase. 快速浏览手册；粗略阅读说明书
words.ex: He skimmed through the manual before the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议前快速浏览了手册。
words.en: To look through a document quickly to get a general idea of its contents.

words.tr: phrase. 弄清楚它是如何运作的；搞明白其工作原理
words.ex: I tried to figure out how it works.
words.ex_cn: 我试着弄明白它是怎么工作的。
words.en: To understand or discover how something functions or operates.

words.tr: phrase. 查看安全提示
words.ex: Please check the safety tips before you start.
words.ex_cn: 开始前请查看安全提示。
words.en: To examine safety instructions or warnings to ensure safe use.

words.tr: phrase. 在网上查找（某事）
words.ex: I don't know the answer, so I will look it up online.
words.ex_cn: 我不知道答案，所以我要在网上查一下。
words.en: To search for information about something on the internet.

words.tr: phrase. 自动运行；自动执行
words.ex: The machine runs automatically when you press the button.
words.ex_cn: 当你按下按钮时，机器会自动运行。
words.en: To operate without the need for manual intervention or control.

words.tr: phrase. 插上电源即可使用；即插即用
words.ex: Plug it in and go to the party.
words.ex_cn: 插上电源，去参加派对吧。
words.en: To connect a device to a power source and start using it immediately.

words.tr: phrase. 调整设置
words.ex: He adjusts the settings on the TV.
words.ex_cn: 他调整电视的设置。
words.en: To modify the configuration or options of a device or system.

words.tr: phrase. 轻松地设置它；轻松地安装或安排
words.ex: He set it up easily with the instructions.
words.ex_cn: 他按照说明轻松地安装好了。
words.en: To install or prepare something for use with minimal difficulty.

words.tr: phrase. 通过蓝牙或无线网络连接
words.ex: He connects his phone via Bluetooth to play music.
words.ex_cn: 他通过蓝牙将手机连接起来播放音乐。
words.en: Establish a wireless connection using Bluetooth or Wi-Fi technology.

words.tr: adj. 免提，免持
words.ex: He uses a hands-free device to talk while driving.
words.ex_cn: 他开车时使用免提设备通话。
words.en: Allowing the user to operate a device without using their hands, typically by voice or automatic controls.

words.tr: phrase. 停止运转；出故障；分解；感情失控
words.ex: The machine broke down yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器昨天坏了。
words.en: If a machine or vehicle breaks down, it stops working. If a discussion, relationship, or system breaks down, it fails because of a problem or disagreement.

words.tr: phrase. 处理重复性任务；负责例行事务
words.ex: The robot takes care of repetitive tasks in the factory.
words.ex_cn: 机器人在工厂里处理重复性任务。
words.en: Handle routine or monotonous duties automatically.

words.tr: phrase. 帮助我保持条理；帮我维持井然有序的状态
words.ex: This app helps me stay organized.
words.ex_cn: 这个应用帮助我保持有条理。
words.en: Assist in maintaining order and structure in one's activities.

words.tr: phrase. 减轻我的工作负担
words.ex: I use a timer to reduce my workload.
words.ex_cn: 我使用计时器来减少我的工作量。
words.en: Lessen the amount of work or effort required.

words.tr: adj. 语音控制的；通过声音指令操作的
words.ex: He uses a voice-controlled device to turn on the lights.
words.ex_cn: 他使用语音控制设备来开灯。
words.en: Operated or controlled by voice commands, as in technology.

words.tr: phrase. 触摸屏界面
words.ex: The phone has a touchscreen interface.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机有一个触摸屏界面。
words.en: A display screen that responds to touch input.

words.tr: phrase. 聪明且反应灵敏的
words.ex: The phone is smart and responsive.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机智能且反应灵敏。
words.en: Intelligent and reacts quickly or appropriately to input.

words.tr: phrase. 坚持按清单行事；不偏离清单
words.ex: He sticks to the list when shopping.
words.ex_cn: 他购物时坚持按清单来。
words.en: Adhere strictly to a predetermined plan or list.

words.tr: phrase. 抑制冲动购物
words.ex: She uses a list to curb impulse buys at the store.
words.ex_cn: 她使用清单来控制在商店里的冲动购物。
words.en: Control or limit spontaneous, unplanned purchases.

words.tr: phrase. 忘记必需品；遗漏基本要素
words.ex: He forgets essentials when he is in a hurry.
words.ex_cn: 当他匆忙时，会忘记基本的东西。
words.en: Fail to remember or bring necessary items.

words.tr: phrase. 管理工作量；合理安排任务负担
words.ex: He must manage workload before the deadline.
words.ex_cn: 他必须在截止日期前管理好工作量。
words.en: To control and distribute work among available resources.

words.tr: phrase. 优先处理任务
words.ex: You need to prioritize tasks to meet the deadline.
words.ex_cn: 你需要优先处理任务以赶上截止日期。
words.en: To prioritize tasks means to decide which tasks are most important and should be dealt with first.

words.tr: phrase. 打勾完成任务；逐项勾选已完成的任务
words.ex: She ticked off tasks on her list.
words.ex_cn: 她把清单上的任务一项项划掉了。
words.en: Mark a task as completed on a checklist.

words.tr: phrase. 压倒性的、难以承受的工作量
words.ex: He feels an overwhelming workload every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周都感到工作量大得难以承受。
words.en: An extremely heavy or excessive amount of work that is difficult to manage.

words.tr: n. 改变游戏规则的人或事物；革新者
words.ex: This new phone is a game-changer.
words.ex_cn: 这部新手机是一个颠覆性的改变。
words.en: A game-changer is a person, idea, or event that completely changes the way something is done, thought about, or made.

words.tr: phrase. 感到受限制；感到拘束
words.ex: He feels constrained when he has to follow strict rules.
words.ex_cn: 当他必须遵守严格规则时，他感到受限制。
words.en: To feel restricted or limited in one's actions or choices.

words.tr: 抑制创造力；扼杀创造性
words.ex: The strict rules are stifling creativity in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 严格的规则正在扼杀课堂上的创造力。
words.en: Preventing the development or expression of new ideas.

words.tr: phrase. 顺其自然；随波逐流；顺应形势
words.ex: He decided to go with the flow and enjoy the day.
words.ex_cn: 他决定顺其自然，享受这一天。
words.en: To go with the flow means to do what other people are doing or to agree with other people because it is the easiest thing to do.

words.tr: adj. 自发的；自然产生的；
words.ex: The children gave a spontaneous cheer.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们自发地欢呼起来。
words.en: Something that is spontaneous is not planned but happens or is done because of a sudden impulse or natural feeling.

words.tr: phrase. 不必要的约束；多余的限制
words.ex: The rule is an unnecessary constraint on students.
words.ex_cn: 这个规则对学生来说是不必要的限制。
words.en: An unnecessary restriction or limitation that hinders progress.

words.tr: phrase. 更喜欢灵活性
words.ex: She prefers flexibility in her work schedule.
words.ex_cn: 她更喜欢工作时间的灵活性。
words.en: To have a greater liking for adaptability and freedom of choice.

words.tr: phrase. 触觉上的满足感
words.ex: The soft fabric gives him tactile satisfaction.
words.ex_cn: 柔软的布料带给他触觉上的满足。
words.en: The pleasure derived from the sense of touch or physical interaction.

words.tr: phrase. 数字便利；数字化带来的便捷性
words.ex: Digital convenience makes shopping easy.
words.ex_cn: 数字便利使购物变得简单。
words.en: The ease and efficiency provided by digital technology and services.

words.tr: phrase. 易于编辑的
words.ex: The document is easily editable on the computer.
words.ex_cn: 这个文档在电脑上很容易编辑。
words.en: Capable of being modified or adjusted with little effort.

words.tr: phrase. 云备份；将数据存储在远程云服务器上以防止本地数据丢失的备份方式
words.ex: He uses cloud backup to save his photos.
words.ex_cn: 他使用云备份来保存他的照片。
words.en: A copy of data stored on a remote server for protection against loss.

words.tr: 在多个设备之间同步（数据或内容）
words.ex: The app is syncing across devices.
words.ex_cn: 这个应用正在跨设备同步。
words.en: The process of keeping files or data consistent across multiple devices.

words.tr: phrase. 匆忙潦草地记笔记
words.ex: He is scribbling notes during the lecture.
words.ex_cn: 他正在上课时潦草地记笔记。
words.en: The act of writing down ideas or information quickly and informally.

words.tr: phrase. 划掉的物理动作；指用手或工具在纸上划掉某项内容的实际行为
words.ex: He made a physical act of crossing off the item from his list.
words.ex_cn: 他亲手把清单上的项目划掉了。
words.en: The action of deleting or marking something as completed or irrelevant.

words.tr: phrase. 对组织至关重要的；组织所必需的
words.ex: Lists are essential for organization.
words.ex_cn: 清单对组织很重要。
words.en: Absolutely necessary for keeping things in order and functioning well.

words.tr: adj. 有预算意识的，注重节省的
words.ex: She is budget-conscious and buys only what she needs.
words.ex_cn: 她很注重预算，只买必需的东西。
words.en: A budget-conscious person is careful about how much they spend and tries to save money by not spending more than necessary.

words.tr: phrase. 防止超支；阻止过度消费
words.ex: The app prevents overspending by limiting daily purchases.
words.ex_cn: 该应用通过限制每日消费来防止超支。
words.en: Helps to avoid spending more money than planned or intended.

words.tr: phrase. 成就感；完成某事后的满足感
words.ex: He felt a sense of accomplishment after finishing the project.
words.ex_cn: 他完成项目后感到一种成就感。
words.en: A feeling of personal satisfaction and pride derived from achieving a goal or completing a task.

words.tr: phrase. 减少心理杂念；减轻思维混乱
words.ex: Meditation reduces mental clutter.
words.ex_cn: 冥想减少心理杂乱。
words.en: Decreases the feeling of being overwhelmed by too many thoughts or tasks.

words.tr: 防止任务从缝隙中溜走（比喻防止任务被遗漏或忽视）
words.ex: The checklist prevents tasks slipping through cracks.
words.ex_cn: 这个清单防止任务被遗漏。
words.en: Ensures that important tasks are not forgotten or overlooked.

words.tr: phrase. 觉得它乏味；认为它单调无聊
words.ex: He finds it tedious to do math homework every day.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得每天做数学作业很枯燥。
words.en: Find an activity boring and tiresome to do.

words.tr: phrase. 对记忆有信心的；确信自己记得清楚的
words.ex: He is confident in memory of his childhood.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的童年记忆很有信心。
words.en: Feeling sure and certain about one's own ability to remember things.

words.tr: phrase. 依靠即兴发挥而蓬勃发展；在即兴创作中茁壮成长
words.ex: The actors thrive on improvisation during live shows.
words.ex_cn: 演员们在现场表演中依靠即兴发挥而表现得出色。
words.en: To succeed or do well in situations that require spontaneous and unplanned actions.

words.tr: phrase. 刚性结构； rigid adj. 坚硬的，刚性的；structure n. 结构，构造
words.ex: The school has a rigid structure with strict rules.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校有一个严格的结构和严格的规则。
words.en: A strict and inflexible system or plan that allows little room for change.

words.tr: phrase. 耗时的行政工作
words.ex: The time-consuming admin tasks slow down the work.
words.ex_cn: 耗时的行政事务拖慢了工作。
words.en: Tasks that require a lot of time and effort to complete, often involving paperwork or routine procedures.

words.tr: phrase. 以纸张（或书面文件）宣誓；凭书面文件起誓
words.ex: He is sworn by paper to keep the secret.
words.ex_cn: 他被纸张誓言约束要保守秘密。
words.en: A method or system that is officially authorized, documented, and considered reliable or binding.

words.tr: 数字技术（或数字方案）以绝对优势胜出
words.ex: Digital wins hands down in speed and convenience.
words.ex_cn: 在速度和便利性上，数字方式完胜。
words.en: Digital methods or solutions are clearly superior and more effective than traditional alternatives.

words.tr: phrase. 混合方法；混合式策略（结合两种或多种不同方法或技术的方案）
words.ex: The teacher uses a hybrid approach to teach math.
words.ex_cn: 老师使用一种混合方法来教数学。
words.en: A strategy or method that combines two different approaches, often traditional and modern, to achieve a goal.

words.tr: phrase. 不那么分散注意力的；干扰较少的
words.ex: The room is less distracting than the cafeteria.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间比食堂少干扰。
words.en: Less likely to divert attention or cause interruption, allowing for better focus on a primary task.

words.tr: phrase. 始终可接近的；一直可使用的；随时可联系的
words.ex: The library is always accessible to students.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆对学生总是开放的。
words.en: Available for use or access at any time, without restriction or limitation.

words.tr: adj.生态意识
words.ex: She is eco-conscious and always uses reusable bags.
words.ex_cn: 她有生态意识，总是使用可重复使用的袋子。
words.en: Being eco-conscious means being aware of the environmental impact of one's actions and making choices that are less harmful to the environment.

words.tr: phrase. 失去……的风险；有失去……的危险
words.ex: He fears the risk of losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他担心失去工作的风险。
words.en: The possibility or danger that something valuable or important may be lost or destroyed.

words.tr: 短语。取决于上下文；视语境而定
words.ex: The answer depends on context.
words.ex_cn: 答案取决于上下文。
words.en: The outcome or best choice varies depending on the specific circumstances or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 迷人的主题；引人入胜的课题
words.ex: Math is a fascinating subject for her.
words.ex_cn: 数学对她来说是一个迷人的科目。
words.en: A topic or field of study that is extremely interesting and captivating.

words.tr: phrase. 自然奇观；大自然的奇迹
words.ex: The Grand Canyon is one of the most famous natural wonders in the world.
words.ex_cn: 大峡谷是世界上最著名的自然奇观之一。
words.en: Natural wonders are extraordinary natural phenomena or places that are considered remarkable and awe-inspiring due to their beauty, size, or uniqueness.

words.tr: phrase. 文化多样性
words.ex: The city celebrates cultural diversity with many food festivals.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市通过许多美食节庆祝文化多样性。
words.en: Cultural diversity refers to the existence of a variety of cultural or ethnic groups within a society.

words.tr: phrase. 全球意识；对全球事务或问题的认知与关注
words.ex: He has global awareness about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他对气候变化有全球性的认识。
words.en: Understanding and knowledge of world events and diverse societies.

words.tr: phrase. 实际应用；实践用途；实用性
words.ex: This math has practical applications in engineering.
words.ex_cn: 这种数学在工程中有实际应用。
words.en: The use of a method or idea in real situations rather than in theory.

words.tr: phrase. 在不熟悉的地方导航；在陌生环境中找到方向
words.ex: He uses a map to navigate unfamiliar places.
words.ex_cn: 他用地图来导航不熟悉的地方。
words.en: To find one's way or manage in areas or situations that are new, unknown, or unfamiliar.

words.tr: phrase. 理解气候模式
words.ex: Scientists try to understand climate patterns.
words.ex_cn: 科学家们试图理解气候模式。
words.en: The ability to comprehend and interpret the recurring weather conditions and long-term climatic trends in a specific region or globally.

words.tr: phrase. 资源分配；资源分布
words.ex: The government plans better resource distribution for poor areas.
words.ex_cn: 政府计划为贫困地区更好地分配资源。
words.en: The geographical arrangement and availability of natural materials, assets, or services across different areas of the world.

words.tr: phrase. 必修课
words.ex: Math is a compulsory course for all students.
words.ex_cn: 数学是所有学生的必修课。
words.en: A compulsory course is a subject that students are required to take as part of their curriculum.

words.tr: phrase. 实地考察；野外旅行
words.ex: The students go on field trips to learn outside the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 学生们参加实地考察，在课堂外学习。
words.en: A field trip is a journey made by a group of people, especially students, to a place away from their normal environment for the purpose of learning or research.

words.tr: 短语。记忆首都（指背诵各国或各地区的首府名称）
words.ex: He is memorizing capitals for his geography test.
words.ex_cn: 他正在为地理考试记忆首都。
words.en: The act of committing to memory the names and locations of the principal cities that serve as the administrative centers of countries or regions.

words.tr: phrase. 地图阅读技能；识图能力
words.ex: He practices map reading skills every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都练习读图技能。
words.en: The practical abilities required to interpret, analyze, and extract information from maps, including symbols, scales, and spatial relationships.

words.tr: phrase. 令人眼界大开的经历；使人恍然大悟的经历
words.ex: Visiting the poor village was an eye-opening experience.
words.ex_cn: 参观贫穷的村庄是一次令人醒悟的经历。
words.en: An event or encounter that profoundly changes one's perspective, broadens understanding, and provides a new, often surprising, insight into the world.

words.tr: phrase. 职业前景；事业发展潜力
words.ex: He wants to improve his career prospect by learning new skills.
words.ex_cn: 他想通过学习新技能来改善职业前景。
words.en: The possibility or likelihood of future success in a career.

words.tr: phrase. 充满热情的教育工作者
words.ex: She is a passionate educator who loves teaching children.
words.ex_cn: 她是一位充满热情的教育者，热爱教孩子。
words.en: A teacher or instructor who exhibits intense enthusiasm, dedication, and fervor for their subject and the process of educating others.

words.tr: phrase. 旅行爱好者；热衷于旅行的人
words.ex: He is a travel enthusiast who visits new countries every year.
words.ex_cn: 他是个旅行爱好者，每年都会去新的国家。
words.en: An individual who has a strong interest and enthusiasm for exploring different countries, cultures, and places around the world.

words.tr: phrase. 开拓视野；扩大眼界
words.ex: Travel can broaden horizons.
words.ex_cn: 旅行可以拓宽视野。
words.en: To increase the range of one's knowledge, understanding, or experience.

words.tr: phrase. 国家概况；国家简介（通常包括一个国家的地理、人口、经济、政治等方面的基本信息）
words.ex: The book shows country profiles for ten nations.
words.ex_cn: 这本书展示了十个国家的概况。
words.en: Concise summaries of key information about a nation, typically including its geography, economy, government, culture, and population.

words.tr: phrase. 政治地理学；研究政治区域、国家边界、领土争端及政府空间组织与地理环境关系的学科
words.ex: He studies political geography to understand borders and countries.
words.ex_cn: 他学习政治地理以了解边界和国家。
words.en: The study of how political power and boundaries are distributed across the Earth's surface.

words.tr: phrase. 地貌；自然特征；身体特征
words.ex: The physical features of this region include mountains and rivers.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区的地貌包括山脉和河流。
words.en: The natural characteristics of a place, such as its mountains, rivers, and forests.

words.tr: phrase. 经济地理学；研究经济活动在地理空间上的分布与组织的学科
words.ex: He studies economic geography to understand where factories are built.
words.ex_cn: 他学习经济地理，以了解工厂建在哪里。
words.en: Economic geography is a branch of geography that studies the location, distribution, and spatial organization of economic activities across the world.

words.tr: phrase. 城市规划；都市计划
words.ex: The city is improving urban planning to reduce traffic.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市正在改进城市规划以减少交通拥堵。
words.en: Urban planning is the process of designing and organizing the physical layout of towns, cities, and other urban areas. It involves the development and use of land, protection and use of the environment, public welfare, and the design of the urban environment, including air, water, and the infrastructure passing into and out of urban areas.

words.tr: phrase. 环境问题；与自然环境相关的各种问题，如污染、气候变化、资源枯竭等
words.ex: Many people care about environmental issues.
words.ex_cn: 许多人关心环境问题。
words.en: Environmental issues refer to problems related to the natural world and the impact of human activity on its condition.

words.tr: phrase. 跨文化理解；指对不同文化背景的人们之间的价值观、信仰、行为方式等的理解与尊重
words.ex: He learns cross-cultural understanding from his foreign friends.
words.ex_cn: 他从他的外国朋友那里学习跨文化理解。
words.en: The knowledge and appreciation of the differences and similarities between cultures, leading to effective and respectful interaction with people from diverse backgrounds.

words.tr: phrase. 地理空间技术，指用于采集、分析、管理和展示地理空间数据的技术，包括地理信息系统（GIS）、遥感、全球定位系统（GPS）等
words.ex: Farmers use geospatial technology to map their fields.
words.ex_cn: 农民使用地理空间技术来绘制他们的田地。
words.en: Digital tools and systems (like GIS) used to collect, analyze, and visualize data related to the Earth's surface, including its physical and human features.

words.tr: adj. 以职业为导向的；重视职业发展的
words.ex: She is very career-oriented and plans to climb the corporate ladder quickly.
words.ex_cn: 她非常以职业为导向，计划快速攀登企业阶梯。
words.en: Focused on or directed towards career advancement and professional success.

words.tr: phrase. 学术兴趣；对学术研究或特定学科领域的关注与爱好
words.ex: He has an academic interest in history.
words.ex_cn: 他对历史有学术兴趣。
words.en: A subject or topic that is studied for its own sake, rather than for practical or professional reasons.

words.tr: phrase. 6. 世界遗产地（指被联合国教科文组织认定具有突出文化或自然价值的地点）
words.ex: Many world heritage sites are protected by the government.
words.ex_cn: 许多世界遗产地受到政府的保护。
words.en: Places of outstanding universal value recognized by UNESCO for their cultural, historical, or natural significance, protected for future generations.

words.tr: phrase. 种群动态；人口动态（研究种群数量、结构及其随时间变化的规律）
words.ex: Scientists study population dynamics in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 科学家研究森林中的种群动态。
words.en: The study of how the size, distribution, and composition of populations change over time and space.

words.tr: phrase. 地缘政治因素；指影响国家间关系和国际局势的地理、政治、经济等因素
words.ex: Geopolitical factors affect trade between countries.
words.ex_cn: 地缘政治因素影响国家之间的贸易。
words.en: Political, economic, and strategic influences that arise from the geographic location and physical features of a region.

words.tr: phrase. 气候变化的影响
words.ex: Climate change impacts farmers every year.
words.ex_cn: 气候变化每年影响农民。
words.en: The effects of long-term shifts in temperatures and weather patterns on ecosystems, human societies, and the environment.

words.tr: phrase. 自然灾害预防
words.ex: The town teaches natural disaster prevention in schools.
words.ex_cn: 这个城镇在学校里教授自然灾害预防。
words.en: The measures and strategies implemented to reduce the risk and impact of natural hazards such as earthquakes, floods, or wildfires.

words.tr: phrase. 文化景观（指人类活动与自然环境相互作用所形成的具有文化意义的地理区域）
words.ex: The farmers preserve cultural landscapes with old stone walls.
words.ex_cn: 农民们用古老的石墙保护着文化景观。
words.en: Areas of land that have been shaped by human activity and culture, reflecting a region's history, traditions, and way of life.

words.tr: phrase. 地理信息系统（用于采集、存储、分析和管理地理空间数据的计算机系统）
words.ex: He uses geographic information systems to map forests.
words.ex_cn: 他使用地理信息系统来绘制森林地图。
words.en: Computer-based systems for capturing, storing, analyzing, and presenting geographic data.

words.tr: phrase. 现场调查研究；田野调查
words.ex: He did field research in the jungle.
words.ex_cn: 他在丛林中进行了实地研究。
words.en: Field research refers to the collection of raw data outside a laboratory, library, or workplace setting. The approaches and methods used in field research vary across disciplines but generally involve direct observation, interviews, and participation in the activities of the community being studied.

words.tr: phrase. 制图技能；地图绘制能力
words.ex: He has strong cartography skills.
words.ex_cn: 他有很强的制图技能。
words.en: The practical abilities needed to create, interpret, and use maps to represent spatial information.

words.tr: phrase. 地方特色（菜肴、产品等）
words.ex: This market sells regional specialties from nearby villages.
words.ex_cn: 这个市场出售来自附近村庄的地方特色产品。
words.en: Distinctive products, practices, or features that are characteristic of a particular geographical area.

words.tr: phrase. 跨学科科目；交叉学科课程
words.ex: Science and art is an interdisciplinary subject.
words.ex_cn: 科学和艺术是一门跨学科的科目。
words.en: A field of study that integrates concepts and methods from multiple traditional academic disciplines.

words.tr: phrase. 世界公民；全球公民（指具有全球视野、关心全球事务并承担相应责任的人）
words.ex: He acts like a global citizen by helping people in different countries.
words.ex_cn: 他通过帮助不同国家的人们，表现得像一个全球公民。
words.en: A person who identifies with and contributes to a global community, transcending national boundaries.

words.tr: phrase. 终身学习；持续一生的学习过程
words.ex: He believes in lifelong learning.
words.ex_cn: 他相信终身学习。
words.en: Lifelong learning refers to the ongoing, voluntary, and self-motivated pursuit of knowledge for either personal or professional reasons. It enhances social inclusion, active citizenship, and personal development, but also self-sustainability, as well as competitiveness and employability.

chapters.name: Topic - Text message 文本消息

words.tr: phrase. 不断地发短信；持续地发送文字信息
words.ex: He texts constantly during class.
words.ex_cn: 他上课时不停地发短信。
words.en: To send or receive written messages electronically in real-time or near real-time.

words.tr: phrase. 即时通讯应用程序
words.ex: He uses instant messaging apps to talk with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他使用即时通讯应用和朋友聊天。
words.en: Software applications that enable real-time text-based communication over the internet.

words.tr: phrase. 初级沟通；主要通信；基本交流方式
words.ex: English is his primary communication language.
words.ex_cn: 英语是他主要的交流语言。
words.en: The main or most important method by which people exchange information or feelings.

words.tr: phrase. 传统短信（Short Message Service），指通过移动通信网络发送的文本消息服务
words.ex: He still uses traditional sms to send messages.
words.ex_cn: 他仍然使用传统的短信来发送消息。
words.en: A standard mobile phone text messaging service that transmits short messages between phones.

words.tr: phrase. 日常必需品；日常生活不可或缺的东西
words.ex: Water is a daily necessity for everyone.
words.ex_cn: 水是每个人每天的必需品。
words.en: A daily necessity refers to something that is essential or required on a daily basis for living or functioning properly.

words.tr: phrase. 文化规范；社会普遍接受的行为准则或价值观
words.ex: Wearing shoes inside is not a cultural norm in Japan.
words.ex_cn: 在日本，穿鞋进屋不是一种文化规范。
words.en: A cultural norm is a rule or expectation of behavior and thoughts based on shared beliefs within a specific cultural or social group.

words.tr: phrase. 代际差异；不同世代之间的观念、行为或价值观等方面的差异
words.ex: There is a generational difference in how they use phones.
words.ex_cn: 他们在使用手机的方式上存在代际差异。
words.en: A notable difference in attitudes, behaviors, or perspectives between people of different age groups.

words.tr: phrase. 青少年时期（通常指13至19岁之间的年龄段）
words.ex: He was very shy during his teenage years.
words.ex_cn: 他在青春期时非常害羞。
words.en: The period of life between childhood and adulthood, typically from the ages of 13 to 19.

words.tr: phrase. 信息过载；消息超载（指接收到过多信息或消息，导致难以处理或理解）
words.ex: He feels message overload from too many texts.
words.ex_cn: 他因为太多短信而感到信息过载。
words.en: An overwhelming volume of messages that can cause stress or reduce the ability to process information.

words.tr: phrase. 即时回应；立即反应
words.ex: He gave an immediate response to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了立即的回应。
words.en: A response that is given without significant delay, often expected in digital communication.

words.tr: phrase. 已读回执；阅读回执（指在消息应用中显示对方已阅读消息的功能）
words.ex: He turned off read receipts on his phone.
words.ex_cn: 他关掉了手机的已读回执。
words.en: A feature in messaging apps that shows when a recipient has viewed a message.

words.tr: phrase. 社会压力；来自社会或群体的影响，促使个体改变行为、态度或信念以符合群体规范
words.ex: He felt social pressure to fit in with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他感到有压力要融入朋友中。
words.en: A feeling of obligation or stress to respond quickly or maintain a certain level of communication.

words.tr: phrase. 延迟的回复；迟复
words.ex: He gave a delayed reply to the email.
words.ex_cn: 他延迟回复了那封邮件。
words.en: A response that is given later than expected or required.

words.tr: phrase. 通知疲劳；指因接收到过多通知或提醒而导致的注意力下降、烦躁或忽视通知的心理状态
words.ex: She feels notification fatigue from too many phone alerts.
words.ex_cn: 她因为太多手机提醒而感到通知疲劳。
words.en: The feeling of being overwhelmed or tired from receiving too many notifications.

words.tr: phrase. 数字排毒；指暂时远离电子设备（如手机、电脑等）以减少对数字技术的依赖并改善身心健康
words.ex: He went to the mountains for a digital detox.
words.ex_cn: 他去山里进行数字排毒。
words.en: A period of time during which a person refrains from using electronic devices.

words.tr: phrase. 信息礼仪；指在发送短信、电子邮件或其他形式的书面信息时应遵循的礼貌和规范准则
words.ex: He follows message etiquette by replying politely.
words.ex_cn: 他通过礼貌地回复来遵守短信礼仪。
words.en: The accepted rules of polite and appropriate behavior when sending messages.

words.tr: phrase. 职业环境；专业场合
words.ex: He speaks clearly in a professional setting.
words.ex_cn: 他在工作场合说话很清晰。
words.en: A situation or environment where professional conduct and language are expected.

words.tr: 随意交谈
words.ex: They had a casual conversation at the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们在公园里进行了一次随意的交谈。
words.en: Informal, relaxed talk between people without a specific purpose or agenda.

words.tr: phrase. 语音消息；语音留言
words.ex: He sent me voice messages every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天给我发语音消息。
words.en: Recorded audio messages sent via messaging apps, as opposed to text or live calls.

words.tr: phrase. 群聊；群组聊天（指多人参与的即时通讯对话）
words.ex: They talk in group chats every day.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天在群聊里聊天。
words.en: Conversations involving multiple participants in a messaging application.

words.tr: phrase. 消息频率；信息发送的频率
words.ex: The message frequency is high during the holiday season.
words.ex_cn: 节日期间消息的频率很高。
words.en: The rate at which messages are sent or received over a period of time.

words.tr: phrase. 沟通习惯；交流习惯
words.ex: His communication habits are very clear and simple.
words.ex_cn: 他的沟通习惯非常清晰简单。
words.en: Regular patterns of behavior in how one exchanges information with others.

words.tr: phrase. 实时交互；即时互动
words.ex: The students have real-time interaction with their teacher online.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在线与老师进行实时互动。
words.en: Immediate, synchronous communication where participants respond without delay, fostering dynamic exchange.

words.tr: phrase. 异步通信；指通信双方不需要同时在线或实时响应的信息传递方式
words.ex: They use asynchronous communication to share messages.
words.ex_cn: 他们使用异步通信来发送消息。
words.en: Communication where participants do not need to be available at the same time.

words.tr: phrase. 紧急事务；急事
words.ex: He must deal with urgent matters now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在必须处理紧急事务。
words.en: Issues or situations that require immediate attention or action.

words.tr: phrase. 工作与生活之间的平衡；指在职业责任和个人生活之间取得适当协调的状态
words.ex: He tries to keep a good work-life balance.
words.ex_cn: 他努力保持良好的工作与生活平衡。
words.en: The equilibrium between an individual's work and personal life, where a person equally prioritizes the demands of one's career and the demands of one's personal life.

words.tr: phrase. 分心管理；干扰管理（指控制或减少注意力分散的策略或方法）
words.ex: He practices distraction management to focus better.
words.ex_cn: 他练习管理干扰以更好地集中注意力。
words.en: Strategies to minimize interruptions and maintain focus while handling digital communications.

words.tr: phrase. 消息存档；信息档案（指已保存的历史消息或通信记录）
words.ex: He checked the message archives for old emails.
words.ex_cn: 他查看了消息归档以寻找旧邮件。
words.en: Stored collections of past electronic messages for reference or retrieval.

words.tr: phrase. 情感基调；情绪色彩
words.ex: The story has a sad emotional tone.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事有一种悲伤的情感基调。
words.en: The emotional quality conveyed by the language and style of a written message.

words.tr: phrase. 误传风险；沟通不畅所带来的风险
words.ex: Miscommunication risks can cause project delays.
words.ex_cn: 沟通失误的风险可能导致项目延误。
words.en: Potential for misunderstandings due to unclear or poorly conveyed information.

words.tr: phrase. 打字速度
words.ex: His typing speed is fast.
words.ex_cn: 他的打字速度很快。
words.en: The rate at which a person types text on a keyboard or touchscreen.

words.tr: phrase. 自动更正失败（指设备或软件未能正确自动修正拼写或输入错误）
words.ex: Auto-correct fails when I type fast.
words.ex_cn: 我打字快的时候，自动更正会出错。
words.en: Errors made by automatic text correction software that alter intended meaning.

words.tr: phrase. 消息草稿；信息草稿
words.ex: He saved the message drafts on his phone.
words.ex_cn: 他把消息草稿保存在手机上。
words.en: Unfinished or preliminary versions of messages saved for later editing or sending.

words.tr: phrase. 离线模式；脱机模式
words.ex: The phone works in offline mode without internet.
words.ex_cn: 手机在离线模式下无需互联网也能工作。
words.en: A feature allowing communication without an active internet connection.

words.tr: phrase. 电池焦虑（指因担心电子设备电量不足而产生的焦虑情绪）
words.ex: He feels battery anxiety when his phone is below 20%.
words.ex_cn: 当他的手机电量低于20%时，他会感到电量焦虑。
words.en: Worry or stress about a device's battery level and potential power loss.

words.tr: phrase. 数据隐私；指保护个人数据不被未经授权访问、使用或泄露的实践或状态
words.ex: She cares about data privacy when she uses apps.
words.ex_cn: 她在使用应用程序时关心数据隐私。
words.en: Data privacy refers to the aspect of information technology (IT) that deals with the ability an organization or individual has to determine what data in a computer system can be shared with third parties.

words.tr: phrase. 消息加密；信息加密（指将消息转换为密文以防止未经授权的访问）
words.ex: He uses message encryption to protect his private data.
words.ex_cn: 他使用消息加密来保护他的私人数据。
words.en: The process of encoding messages to prevent unauthorized access or reading.

words.tr: phrase. 垃圾信息；垃圾短信（指未经请求而大量发送的电子信息，通常为广告或欺诈内容）
words.ex: He gets spam messages every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都会收到垃圾信息。
words.en: Unwanted, unsolicited electronic messages, often promotional or malicious, sent in bulk.

words.tr: phrase. 未读数量；未读计数
words.ex: The unread count on her phone is five.
words.ex_cn: 她手机上的未读消息数量是五条。
words.en: The number of unread messages in an inbox or messaging app.

words.tr: phrase. 回复焦虑（指在需要回复消息或邮件时产生的紧张、担忧或压力感）
words.ex: He feels reply anxiety before sending a message.
words.ex_cn: 他在发送消息前感到回复焦虑。
words.en: A feeling of stress or reluctance to respond to messages, often due to pressure or fear of judgment.

words.us: aɪd kənˈsɪdər maɪˈself ə ˈhevi ˈtekstər
words.ex: I'd consider myself a heavy texter.
words.ex_cn: 我会认为自己是个发短信很多的人。
words.en: I consider myself someone who frequently sends and receives text messages.

words.ex: It's become the dominant communication method where even formal matters are increasingly handled through messaging apps rather than emails or calls.
words.ex_cn: 它已成为主导的沟通方式，甚至正式事务也越来越多地通过即时通讯应用处理，而不是通过电子邮件或电话。
words.en: Text-based messaging has become the primary means of communication, even for formal matters, replacing emails or phone calls.

words.us: aɪ ˈpræktɪs ˈsɛlɛktɪv ɪˌmidɪˈæsəti - rɪˈspɑndɪŋ ˈprɑmptli tu ˈɝdʒənt ˈmætɚz waɪl ˈbætʃɪŋ nɑn-ˈkrɪtɪkəl ˈmɛsɪdʒɪz tu spəˈsɪfɪk taɪmz tu meɪnˈteɪn foʊkəs
words.ex: I practice selective immediacy by answering urgent emails right away and checking other messages only at noon.
words.ex_cn: 我通过立即回复紧急邮件，只在中午查看其他消息来实践选择性即时响应。
words.en: I respond immediately to urgent messages but group non-urgent ones to be handled at specific times to preserve concentration.

words.tr: phrase. 创意发泄途径；创造性表达方式
words.ex: Painting is her creative outlet.
words.ex_cn: 绘画是她的创意发泄方式。
words.en: A means of expressing oneself creatively, often through art, writing, or other activities.

words.tr: phrase. 写日记的习惯
words.ex: He has a journaling habit every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都有写日记的习惯。
words.en: The regular practice of writing down one's thoughts and experiences in a diary or journal.

words.tr: phrase. 个人反思；个人感悟；个人思考
words.ex: He wrote down his personal reflections after the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他在旅行后写下了自己的个人反思。
words.en: Thoughts and feelings about one's own experiences, often written or spoken for self-understanding.

words.tr: phrase. 情绪释放；情感宣泄

words.ex_cn: 他和家人一起庆祝自己的人生重要时刻。
words.en: Significant personal achievements or events in one's life journey.

words.w: Something triggers the release of dopamine which is associated with pleasure something

words.uk: ˈsʌmθɪŋ ˈtrɪɡəz ðə rɪˈliːs ɒv ˈdəʊpəmiːn wɪtʃ ɪz əˈsəʊsieɪtɪd wɪð ˈpleʒə
words.us: ˈsʌmθɪŋ ˈtrɪɡərz ðə rɪˈlis əv ˈdoʊpəmiːn wɪtʃ ɪz əˈsoʊsieɪtɪd wɪð ˈpleʒər
words.ex: Eating chocolate triggers the release of dopamine.
words.ex_cn: 吃巧克力会引发多巴胺的释放。
words.en: An event that causes the brain to release dopamine, a neurotransmitter linked to pleasure.

words.w: Bring a sense of novelty and variety into life
words.tr: v. 为生活带来新鲜感和多样性

words.ex: Traveling brings a sense of novelty and variety into life.
words.ex_cn: 旅行为生活带来新鲜感和多样性。
words.en: Introduce new and diverse experiences to make life more interesting.

words.tr: phrase. 提高生活质量
words.ex: Exercise can improve quality of life.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以提高生活质量。
words.en: To make life better by enhancing living conditions, health, or happiness.

words.tr: v. 提升舒适度与便利性
words.ex: The new seat enhances comfort and convenience.
words.ex_cn: 新座椅提升了舒适性和便利性。
words.en: Improve ease and comfort in daily activities.

words.w: Can be linked to social status

words.ex: His job can be linked to social status.
words.ex_cn: 他的工作可以与社会地位相关联。
words.en: May be associated with one's social standing or perceived position in society.

words.w: The desire for acceptance or admiration from others

words.us: ðə dɪˈzaɪr fɔːr əkˈseptəns ɔːr ˌædmɪˈreɪʃn frʌm ˈʌðərz

words.tr: 帮助人们应对压力

words.ex_cn: 她通过教呼吸练习来帮助人们应对压力。
words.en: Assisting individuals in managing and dealing with stressful situations.

words.tr: n. 无聊；
words.ex: He felt boredom during the long meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在漫长的会议中感到无聊。
words.en: Boredom is the state of feeling bored.

words.tr: 或负面情绪
words.ex: He tries to avoid or negative emotions.
words.ex_cn: 他试图避免或负面情绪。
words.en: Or feelings of sadness, anger, or anxiety.
